Volkswagen Polo 1995-2002 Repair Manuals

Models Covered:

  • Volkswagen Polo (6N: 1995–1999)

  • Volkswagen Polo (6N2 facelift: 1999–2002)

  • Polo Classic sedan (from 1996)

  • Polo Variant station wagon (from 1998)

Main Sections:

  • Maintenance (Polo, Classic, Variant)

  • Engines:

    • 3-cylinder diesel (AMF)

    • 4-cylinder petrol and diesel engines with various codes (AFH, AJV, APE, AUA, ARC, AVY, AFT, ADZ, ADX, AEA, AEE, AER, AEV, AEX, AKV, ALL, ANX, APQ, AKK, ANW, AUD, AEH, AKL, APF, AUR, AFK, AHW, AQQ, AGP, AGR, ALH, AQM, ASV, AYQ, AEY, AFN, AHB, AHU, AKW, ALE, 1Y, AEF, AGD, AHG, AKU, ASX)

  • Fuel injection and ignition systems:

    • 1AV, 4AV, 4LV, 4CV injection systems

    • Simos, Motronic, Mono Motronic

    • Diesel glow plug and injection systems

  • Transmission systems:

    • Automatic gearboxes 01M, 001 (with self-diagnosis)

    • Manual gearboxes 4-speed and 5-speed (020, 02K, 02J, 02A, 085)

  • Running gear, suspension, steering (periods 1995–1998 and 1998–2002)

  • ABS system self-diagnosis (1995–1998 and 1998–2002)

  • Wheels and tyres guides

  • Brake systems

  • Heating and air conditioning (1995–1998 and 1998–2002)

  • Bodywork repairs: exterior and interior (Polo, Classic, Variant)

  • Body electronic system self-diagnosis

  • Radio, telephone, navigation systems

  • Electrical systems and wiring diagrams (1994–2002)

  • Trailer usage guide (up to 2016)

  • Index and archives
